240-5470-7297-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1832-4050-4699.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-4699.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1874-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2350-2781-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-3967-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-3967-4871-6255.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-7692.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mercurial Pretender dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Mercurial Pretender that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Mercurial Pretender token instead.
2523-2869-3504.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

64-2103-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

774-5621-6664.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Arid Archway's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

252-1575-4779-5776.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

997-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
997-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2921-6529-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1778-2829-5220-6900.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-2423-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-2423-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Bounding Krasis and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Bounding Krasis and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Bounding Krasis and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Bounding Krasis tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-2423-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Bounding Krasis. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

671-1274-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3609-5200-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
3609-5200-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3609-5200-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well. This includes using Sword of the Paruns to tap Kilo, which will require an additional {9} each turn.

628-2018-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Bloodflow Connoisseur didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Bloodflow Connoisseur is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
628-2018-2511.notes: You may instead sacrifice another nontoken creature that isn't a Human and does not have flying instead of Bloodflow Connoisseur.

4451-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
4451-6185-6280.description:
Activate Greater Mossdog's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Greater Mossdog from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

222-527-5147-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-5147-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1309-1987-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1309-1987-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

5147-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5147-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

342-577-2206-3080.description:
Optionally, you may activate Gingerbrute's first ability by paying {0}, causing it to only be blockable by creatures with haste this turn.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Soldevi Simulacrum and Gingerbrute.
Activate Gingerbrute by paying {0}, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 4.

586-1799-2048-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {R}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-5147.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

678-2226-5147.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
678-2226-5147.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Zacama.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.

1339-1636-5028.notablePrerequisites: Arcanis the Omnipotent does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-5028.description:
Activate Arcanis by tapping it, drawing three cards.
The Locust God triggers three times.
Resolve the first Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

541-2104-3395-3634.notablePrerequisites:
{5}{U}{U}{U}{U} available each turn.
An additional {3} or {U} available to activate Crystal Shard.
541-2104-3395-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Crystal Shard by tapping it and paying {3} or {U}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

225-539-1257-5233.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
